subject: rmarkdown error: No issues when launching app from Rstudio, error when accessing through web broswer

messages.author: 4bb79690b5eaf556
messages.subject: rmarkdown error: No issues when launching app from Rstudio, error when accessing through web broswer
parts:
I am developing an app on a linux R server that renders a report using rmarkdown.  
1) When I launch the app from Rstudio, the report renders and downloads with no issues.  
2) When I access the app through a web browser, I get an error: "error in running command".

Note: The exact same files are used for 1 and 2. To be specific, the files used for 1 and 2 not copies of the same files at different paths, the files used are at the exact same path.


The log reports the error as follows:

sh: /opt/shiny-server/ext/pandoc/pandoc: No such file or directory

Error in system(paste(shQuote(pandoc_path), "--version"), intern = TRUE) :

  error in running command


The code used to create render the report is based on Rstudio's knitr example:
output$downloadReport <- downloadHandler( filename = 'scorecard.docx' , content = function(file) { src <- normalizePath('/appl/shiny/ali/helpers/scorecard.Rmd') # temporarily switch to the temp dir, in case you do not have write # permission to the current working directory owd <- setwd(tempdir()) on.exit(setwd(owd)) file.copy(src, 'scorecard.Rmd') library(rmarkdown) out <- render('scorecard.Rmd', word_document()) file.rename(out, file) } )

I am running,
R version 3.1.2
Rstudio Version 0.99.442
rmarkdown 0.7
kknitr_1.10.5
shiny_0.12.1

messages.author: 4bb79690b5eaf556
messages.subject: Re: rmarkdown error: No issues when launching app from Rstudio, error when accessing through web broswer
parts: Issue resolution: The shiny-server install was missing a pandoc file, reinstalling shiny-server resolved the issue.
